about.text: Built on years of hands-on experience, our team specializes in the diagnostics, repair and maintenance of heavy machinery — from excavators to mining equipment. Our goal is simple: minimize your machine downtime.

intro.title: Our Services
intro.lead: Complete service for every major system of your heavy equipment — under one roof.

excavator.title: Excavator Repair
excavator.short: Mechanical diagnostics, engine and hydraulic repair — in one place.
excavator.description: We specialize in complete diagnostics and repair of excavators. From mechanical failures to engine and hydraulic system problems — we restore your machine to factory specifications.
excavator.equipment: Crawler and wheeled excavators by Caterpillar, Komatsu, Hitachi, Volvo, Doosan, Hyundai and other brands

maintenance.title: Heavy Equipment Maintenance
maintenance.short: Scheduled maintenance, fleet support and preventive inspections.
maintenance.description: Scheduled maintenance prevents unexpected breakdowns. We build a tailored service schedule for your fleet and document everything — from filter and oil changes to full inspections.
maintenance.equipment: Construction and mining equipment fleets of all types

hydraulics.title: Hydraulic Systems
hydraulics.short: Repair and restoration of pumps, cylinders and valves.
hydraulics.description: Hydraulics are the heart of heavy machinery. We have the equipment to diagnose, repair and test hydraulic pumps, cylinders, valves and hydraulic motors.
hydraulics.equipment: Excavators, loaders, bulldozers and other machines with hydraulic systems

engine.title: Engine & Transmission Service
engine.short: Overhaul of diesel engines and transmissions.
engine.description: Diagnostics, running repairs and complete overhauls of diesel engines and drivetrains. We work to factory tolerances and hand over tested, verified machines.
engine.equipment: Industrial diesel engines of all major brands

field.title: Field Service
field.short: On-site repair and emergency support at your job site.
field.description: Machines can't always be brought to the workshop. Our mobile service crews come directly to your site with the right tools and spare parts and carry out repairs on the spot.
field.equipment: All types of self-propelled construction and mining machinery

parts.title: Spare Parts & Technical Support
parts.short: Supply of quality parts and expert advice.
parts.description: We organize fast supply of genuine and OEM-standard spare parts and provide technical guidance on the right selection. Parts and installation — from a single source.
parts.equipment: Heavy machinery of all major brands

intro.title: Kaya Makina
intro.lead: A Baku-based engineering team specialized in the repair and maintenance of heavy machinery.

story.title: Trust built on experience
story.p1: Kaya Makina was built on years of hands-on experience in the heavy machinery sector. What began as a small workshop has grown into a professional service center covering a wide range of machines — from excavators to mining equipment.
story.p2: Today we keep the fleets of construction companies and infrastructure contractors running. We approach every repair with engineering precision and guarantee the result.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.text: To minimize our customers' heavy equipment downtime — through professional diagnostics, quality repair and responsive field support.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.text: To be the first choice for heavy machinery service in Azerbaijan and bring internationally benchmarked service standards to the local market.

approach.title: The engineering approach
approach.lead: Every repair is built on four principles.

diagnostics.title: Accurate diagnosis first
diagnostics.text: We never start a repair before finding the root cause of the failure.

parts.title: Right part, right tool
parts.text: We work with genuine/OEM parts and calibrated equipment.

safety.title: Safety first
safety.text: All work is carried out to industrial safety standards.

transparency.title: Transparent process
transparency.text: Full accountability on price, timeline and the work performed.

team.title: A professional team
team.text: Our team consists of certified mechanics, hydraulics specialists and field engineers. Continuous training keeps our expertise current with the newest generations of equipment.
